claim: Vitamin D supplementation reduces severe COVID-19 hospitalization risk by 50%.
label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
evidence_text: Observational study of 200 patients showed lower ICU admission rates in patients with adequate serum 25(OH)D levels.

claim: Ivermectin eliminates viral load within 24 hours in all human subjects.
label: REFUTE
evidence_text: In vitro high-dose cell culture study demonstrated viral replication inhibition; human clinical trials showed no statistically significant clearance at safe dosages.

claim: mRNA vaccines induce robust neutralizing antibody response against SARS-CoV-2 spike protein.
label: SUPPORT
evidence_text: Phase 3 clinical trial demonstrated 95% efficacy in preventing symptomatic infection with elevated IgG titers.
